overview: A dedicated upload service streams photos to S3 and enqueues processing; simpler auth and validation, more bandwidth on your fleet.

estimation.calculation: 10,000,000 × 2 MB = 20 TB/day before variants and replicas.
estimation.result: Media bandwidth and storage dominate small metadata records.
estimation.implication: Upload directly or through a dedicated fleet; generate variants asynchronously and deliver through CDN.

accessPatterns: Create upload metadata; list READY posts in feed order.
constraints: Use conditional transitions so duplicate thumbnail jobs cannot regress READY to PROCESSING.
relationships: media_keys reference PhotoObject variants; publish READY only when required variants exist.

entityDetails.purpose: Immutable photo originals and generated variants.
accessPatterns: Upload an original; CDN fetches the appropriate published variant.
constraints: Signed uploads constrain size/type; publish only validated variants; revoke visibility at the metadata layer.
relationships: post_id associates originals and variants with Post; metadata controls feed visibility.

apiDetails.rationale: Presigned mode transfers bytes to object storage; upload-service mode streams them through the upload fleet.

apiDetails.purpose: Verify upload completion and schedule processing.
apiDetails.rationale: A retry must not enqueue unbounded duplicate processing; confirm the referenced object belongs to the user.
Return CDN URLs for READY variants, not original photo bytes through the API.

steps.title: Upload Service → Thumbnail jobs → Thumbnailers → Photos
steps.explanation: Queue deterministic variant processing after a complete upload.

steps.title: Thumbnailers → Posts
steps.explanation: Commit READY metadata only after variant completion is verified.

steps.explanation: Fetch feed IDs and ready metadata.

failureCases.scenario: Thumbnail job is duplicated or a variant fails
failureCases.handling: Use deterministic object keys and conditional metadata transitions. Retry failed variants; keep the post PROCESSING or show an explicit placeholder instead of broken media.

alternatives: Use presigned uploads to bypass app-tier media bandwidth. Use an upload service when inline validation and scanning justify the additional bandwidth and scaling cost.
